pretreatment: successively cleaned in acetone, absolute alcohol and deionized (DI) water with ultrasonic bath
evidence: A 50 mm c-plane single crystal sapphire with <0 0 0 1> orientation and 0.5 mm thickness (Al2O3 > 99.99%). Before deposition, the substrate was successively cleaned in acetone, absolute alcohol and deionized (DI) water with ultrasonic bath. Finally the substrate was dried by pure N2 gas.
